title.en: Guided walk: from listing to the guests who book you
title.af: Begeleide staptog: van advertensie tot die gaste wat jou bespreek
title.zu: Uhambo oluholwayo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya ezivakashini ezikubhukhayo
title.xh: Uhambo olukhokelwayo: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kwiindwendwe ezikubhukishayo
title.nso: Leeto le le hlahlwago: go tloga papatšong go ya go baeng bao ba go beeletšago

en: Tap [[Sell]], then [[Adventures]]
In TrustSquare tap [[Sell]] at the bottom and choose [[Adventures]].
af: Tik [[Sell]], dan [[Adventures]]
Tik in TrustSquare onder op [[Sell]] en kies [[Adventures]].
zu: Thepha [[Sell]], bese [[Adventures]]
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Sell]] ngezansi bese ukhetha [[Adventures]].
xh: Cofa [[Sell]], emva koko [[Adventures]]
Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Sell]] ezantsi uze ukhethe [[Adventures]].
nso: Kgotla [[Sell]], ke moka [[Adventures]]
Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Sell]] ka fase gomme o kgethe [[Adventures]].

en: Pick [[Experiences]]
Experiences are things people do: hikes, water sports, wildlife, tours, sky and extreme.
af: Kies [[Experiences]]
Ervarings is dinge wat mense doen: staptogte, watersport, wild, toere, lug en ekstreem.
zu: Khetha [[Experiences]]
Okuhlangenwe nakho yizinto abantu abazenzayo: ukuhamba ngezinyawo, imidlalo yasemanzini, izilwane zasendle, uhambo, isibhakabhaka nokweqisayo.
xh: Khetha [[Experiences]]
Amava zizinto abantu abazenzayo: ukuhamba ngeenyawo, imidlalo yamanzi, izilwanyana zasendle, ukhenketho, isibhakabhaka nokugqithisileyo.
nso: Kgetha [[Experiences]]
Maitemogelo ke dilo tšeo batho ba di dirago: go sepela ka maoto, dipapadi tša meetse, diphoofolo tša naga, maeto, lefaufau le tše di feteletšego.

en: Add photos of the day
Start with people doing it, then the view. The app checks every photo and blurs faces and number plates.
af: Voeg foto's van die dag by
Begin met mense wat dit doen, dan die uitsig. Die toep kyk na elke foto en maak gesigte en nommerplate dof.
zu: Engeza izithombe zosuku
Qala ngabantu abakwenzayo, bese kuba umbono. I-app ihlola zonke izithombe futhi ifiphaze ubuso namapuleti ezinombolo.
xh: Yongeza iifoto zosuku
Qala ngabantu abakwenzayo, emva koko imbonakalo. I-app ihlola yonke ifoto ize ifiphaze ubuso neepleyiti zeenombolo.
nso: Oketša diswantšho tša letšatši
Thoma ka batho ba ba e dirago, ke moka pono. App e hlahloba seswantšho se sengwe le se sengwe gomme e fifatša difahlego le dipoleiti tša dinomoro.

en: Say what it is, how long and for how many
The activity, how long it takes, the smallest and biggest group, the area, the [[Environment]] and your price per person. The exact meeting point stays private.
af: Sê wat dit is, hoe lank en vir hoeveel
Die aktiwiteit, hoe lank dit duur, die kleinste en grootste groep, die area, die [[Environment]] en jou prys per persoon. Die presiese ontmoetplek bly privaat.
zu: Yisho ukuthi kuyini, kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi kungabantu abangaki
Umsebenzi, isikhathi owuthathayo, iqembu elincane nelikhulu, indawo, i-[[Environment]] nentengo yakho ngomuntu. Indawo eqondile yokuhlangana ihlala iyimfihlo.
xh: Yitsho ukuba yintoni, ithatha ixesha elingakanani nokuba ngabantu abangaphi
Umsebenzi, ixesha owuthathayo, elona qela lincinci nelona likhulu, indawo, i-[[Environment]] nexabiso lakho ngomntu. Indawo echanekileyo yokudibana ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Bolela gore ke eng, e tšea nako ye kae le gore ke ba bakae
Mošomo, nako ye o e tšeago, sehlopha se se nyenyane le se segolo, lefelo, [[Environment]] le theko ya gago ka motho. Lefelo la nnete la go kopana le dula e le sephiri.

en: Say what is included, how hard it is and the best season
What is included and what is not, the [[Fitness level]] and the [[Best season]]. Guests see both on your card before they ask.
af: Sê wat ingesluit is, hoe moeilik dit is en die beste seisoen
Wat ingesluit is en wat nie, die [[Fitness level]] en die [[Best season]]. Gaste sien albei op jou kaart voordat hulle vra.
zu: Yisho okufakiwe, ukuthi kunzima kangakanani nesikhathi sonyaka esihle kakhulu
Okufakiwe nokungafakiwe, i-[[Fitness level]] ne-[[Best season]]. Izivakashi zibona kokubili ekhadini lakho ngaphambi kokuba zibuze.
xh: Yitsho okuqukiweyo, ukuba kunzima kangakanani nexesha lonyaka elilungileyo
Okuqukiweyo nokungaqukwanga, i-[[Fitness level]] ne-[[Best season]]. Iindwendwe zibona zombini kwikhadi lakho phambi kokuba zibuze.
nso: Bolela seo se akaretšwago, gore go thata gakaakang le sehla se se kaone
Seo se akaretšwago le seo se sa akaretšwago, [[Fitness level]] le [[Best season]]. Baeng ba bona ka bobedi karateng ya gago pele ba botšiša.

en: Say how you keep people safe
Your guide registration, first aid and liability insurance. Upload the proof later: points count once a person has checked it.
af: Sê hoe jy mense veilig hou
Jou gidsregistrasie, noodhulp en aanspreeklikheidsversekering. Laai later die bewys op: punte tel sodra 'n mens dit nagegaan het.
zu: Yisho ukuthi ubaphephisa kanjani abantu
Ukubhaliswa kwakho njengomhlahlandlela, usizo lokuqala nomshwalense wesikweletu. Layisha ubufakazi kamuva: amaphuzu ayabalwa uma umuntu esebuhlolile.
xh: Yitsho ukuba ubakhusela njani abantu
Ubhaliso lwakho njengomkhokeli, uncedo lokuqala ne-inshorensi yetyala. Layisha ubungqina kamva: amanqaku abalwa xa umntu ebuhlolile.
nso: Bolela ka moo o bolokago batho
Ngwadišo ya gago bjalo ka mohlahli, thušo ya pele le inšorense ya maikarabelo. Laiša bohlatse ka morago: dintlha di balwa ge motho a bo hlahlobile.

en: Tick your extras
[[Private groups]], [[Photos included]] and the rest. They make your listing richer.
af: Merk jou ekstras
[[Private groups]], [[Photos included]] en die res. Hulle maak jou advertensie ryker.
zu: Maka izinto ezengeziwe
[[Private groups]], [[Photos included]] nokunye. Zenza isikhangiso sakho sicebe kakhulu.
xh: Phawula izinto ezongezelelweyo
[[Private groups]], [[Photos included]] nokunye. Zenza intengiso yakho ityebe ngakumbi.
nso: Swaya dilo tša tlaleletšo
[[Private groups]], [[Photos included]] le tše dingwe. Di dira gore papatšo ya gago e humile.

en: Read the legal side
A registered guide, a written risk notice, insurance, first aid and permits: what you need in South Africa. It is general guidance, not legal advice.
af: Lees die regskant
'n Geregistreerde gids, 'n skriftelike risikokennisgewing, versekering, noodhulp en permitte: wat jy in Suid-Afrika nodig het. Dit is algemene riglyne, nie regsadvies nie.
zu: Funda uhlangothi lwezomthetho
Umhlahlandlela obhalisiwe, isaziso esibhaliwe sobungozi, umshwalense, usizo lokuqala nezimvume: lokho okudingayo eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisiqondiso esijwayelekile, akusona iseluleko somthetho.
xh: Funda icala lomthetho
Umkhokeli obhalisiweyo, isaziso esibhaliweyo somngcipheko, i-inshorensi, uncedo lokuqala neemvume: oko ukufunayo eMzantsi Afrika. Sisikhokelo ngokubanzi, asiyongcebiso yomthetho.
nso: Bala lehlakore la molao
Mohlahli yo a ngwadišitšwego, tsebišo ye e ngwadilwego ya kotsi, inšorense, thušo ya pele le diphemiti: seo o se hlokago ka Afrika Borwa. Ke tlhahlo ya kakaretšo, ga se keletšo ya molao.

en: Check your score and publish
Your score shows what would lift you higher in search. Tap [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
af: Kyk na jou telling en publiseer
Jou telling wys wat jou hoër in soektogte sal lig. Tik [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
zu: Bheka amaphuzu akho bese ushicilela
Amaphuzu akho akhombisa okungakuphakamisa ekusesheni. Thepha [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
xh: Jonga amanqaku akho uze upapashe
Amanqaku akho abonisa oko kunokukuphakamisa ekukhangeleni. Cofa [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
nso: Lebelela dintlha tša gago gomme o phatlalatše
Dintlha tša gago di bontšha seo se ka go phagamišago ka go nyakišišo. Kgotla [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].

en: You are live
Guests can find you and ask for an introduction straight away. Upload your ID in [[My Space]], then [[Trust]], so they see you are checked.
af: Jy is lewendig
Gaste kan jou dadelik vind en vra vir 'n bekendstelling. Laai jou ID op in [[My Space]], dan [[Trust]], sodat hulle sien jy is nagegaan.
zu: Usuphilayo
Izivakashi zingakuthola futhi zicele ukwethulwa ngokushesha. Layisha i-ID yakho ku-[[My Space]], bese [[Trust]], ukuze zibone ukuthi uhloliwe.
xh: Uphilayo ngoku
Iindwendwe zingakufumana kwaye zicele ukwaziswa kwangoko. Layisha i-ID yakho kwi-[[My Space]], emva koko [[Trust]], ukuze zibone ukuba uhloliwe.
nso: O phela bjale
Baeng ba ka go hwetša gomme ba kgopela go tsebišwa gona bjale. Laiša ID ya gago go [[My Space]], ke moka [[Trust]], gore ba bone gore o hlahlobilwe.

en: A guest opens Adventures and taps [[Experiences]]
She sees things to do only.
af: 'n Gas maak Adventures oop en tik [[Experiences]]
Sy sien net dinge om te doen.
zu: Isivakashi sivula i-Adventures bese sithepha [[Experiences]]
Sibona izinto zokwenza kuphela.
xh: Undwendwe luvula i-Adventures luze lucofe [[Experiences]]
Lubona izinto zokwenza kuphela.
nso: Moeng o bula Adventures gomme o kgotla [[Experiences]]
O bona dilo tša go dira feela.

en: She picks the surroundings she wants
In [[Filtered Search]] she taps an [[Environment]], like [[Bush & Wildlife]], then [[Show results]].
af: Sy kies die omgewing wat sy wil hê
In [[Filtered Search]] tik sy 'n [[Environment]], soos [[Bush & Wildlife]], dan [[Show results]].
zu: Sikhetha indawo esiyifunayo
Ku-[[Filtered Search]] sithepha i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Bush & Wildlife]], bese [[Show results]].
xh: Lukhetha indawo olufuna yona
Kwi-[[Filtered Search]] lucofa i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Bush & Wildlife]], emva koko [[Show results]].
nso: O kgetha tikologo yeo a e nyakago
Go [[Filtered Search]] o kgotla [[Environment]], bjalo ka [[Bush & Wildlife]], ke moka [[Show results]].

en: Your walk is there, with its level and season
Your card shows how hard it is and when it is best: 🥾 Moderate · 📅 Best in winter.
af: Jou staptog is daar, met sy vlak en seisoen
Jou kaart wys hoe moeilik dit is en wanneer dit die beste is: 🥾 Moderate · 📅 Best in winter.
zu: Uhambo lwakho lukhona, nezinga nesikhathi sonyaka
Ikhadi lakho likhombisa ukuthi kunzima kangakanani nokuthi kuhle nini: 🥾 Moderate · 📅 Best in winter.
xh: Uhambo lwakho lukhona, nenqanaba nexesha lonyaka
Ikhadi lakho libonisa ukuba kunzima kangakanani nokuba kulungile nini: 🥾 Moderate · 📅 Best in winter.
nso: Leeto la gago le gona, le maemo le sehla
Karata ya gago e bontšha gore go thata gakaakang le gore go kaone neng: 🥾 Moderate · 📅 Best in winter.

en: She reads your listing
Your price per person, your area, the environment, the level, the best season and what is included. Your name stays private.
af: Sy lees jou advertensie
Jou prys per persoon, jou area, die omgewing, die vlak, die beste seisoen en wat ingesluit is. Jou naam bly privaat.
zu: Sifunda isikhangiso sakho
Intengo yakho ngomuntu, indawo yakho, okukuzungezile, izinga, isikhathi sonyaka esihle nokufakiwe. Igama lakho lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Lufunda intengiso yakho
Ixabiso lakho ngomntu, indawo yakho, okukujikelezileyo, inqanaba, ixesha lonyaka elilungileyo nokuqukiweyo. Igama lakho lihlala liyimfihlo.
nso: O bala papatšo ya gago
Theko ya gago ka motho, lefelo la gago, tikologo, maemo, sehla se se kaone le seo se akaretšwago. Leina la gago le dula e le sephiri.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short question. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort vraag. 1 Tuppence word van haar teruggehou en net bestee as jy aanvaar.
zu: Sicela ukwethulwa
Sibhala umbuzo omfushane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuso, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Lucela ukwaziswa
Lubhala umbuzo omfutshane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kulo, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala potšišo ye kopana. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: Read her question
Open [[My Space]], then [[Intros]]. Her message shows under her request.
af: Lees haar vraag
Maak [[My Space]] oop, dan [[Intros]]. Haar boodskap wys onder haar versoek.
zu: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]], bese [[Intros]]. Umlayezo wakhe uvela ngaphansi kwesicelo sakhe.
xh: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]], emva koko [[Intros]]. Umyalezo wakhe uvela phantsi kwesicelo sakhe.
nso: Bala potšišo ya gagwe
Bula [[My Space]], ke moka [[Intros]]. Molaetša wa gagwe o tšwelela ka fase ga kgopelo ya gagwe.

en: Accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle albei kry 'n e-pos: antwoord dit om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Yamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: yiphendule ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Yamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: yiphendule ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She sees you accepted
Her [[Intros]] say [[Accepted]], and her 1 Tuppence is spent.
af: Sy sien jy het aanvaar
Haar [[Intros]] sê [[Accepted]], en haar 1 Tuppence is bestee.
zu: Sibona ukuthi wamukele
Ama-[[Intros]] aso athi [[Accepted]], futhi i-Tuppence yaso e-1 isisetshenzisiwe.
xh: Lubona ukuba wamkele
Ii-[[Intros]] zalo zithi [[Accepted]], kwaye i-Tuppence yalo e-1 isetyenzisiwe.
nso: O bona gore o amogetše
Di-[[Intros]] tša gagwe di re [[Accepted]], gomme Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišitšwe.

en: Put your walk on your WhatsApp Status
In your [[Seller Hub]] tap [[Share to Status]]. A card with your walk, your price and your link opens: save it and post it.
af: Sit jou staptog op jou WhatsApp Status
Tik in jou [[Seller Hub]] op [[Share to Status]]. 'n Kaart met jou staptog, jou prys en jou skakel maak oop: stoor dit en plaas dit.
zu: Beka uhambo lwakho ku-WhatsApp Status yakho
Ku-[[Seller Hub]] yakho thepha [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinohambo lwakho, intengo yakho nesixhumanisi sakho: lilondoloze bese ulifaka.
xh: Beka uhambo lwakho kwi-WhatsApp Status yakho
Kwi-[[Seller Hub]] yakho cofa [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinohambo lwakho, ixabiso lakho nekhonkco lakho: ligcine uze ulifake.
nso: Bea leeto la gago go WhatsApp Status ya gago
Go [[Seller Hub]] ya gago kgotla [[Share to Status]]. Karata ye e nago le leeto la gago, theko ya gago le kgokagano ya gago e a bulega: e boloke gomme o e tsenye.
